title: Democratic Impact Monitor: Prevention of Custodial Torture Violence and Accountability Bill
objective: Eliminate custodial deaths, torture, and un-explicated injuries in police custody.

indicators.name: Custodial Mortality and Injury Rate
indicators.definition: Annual total number of custodial deaths and reported injuries across all police stations.

oversight.body: National Human Rights Commission Custodial Monitoring Board
oversight.composition: Judges, medical examiners, human rights advocates

complaints.appeal_route: High Court / Special Human Rights Court

triggers.condition: Report of custodial death or severe injury during police detention.
triggers.responsible_body: Special Human Rights Court & Judicial Magistrate
triggers.interim_protection: Immediate suspension and arrest of custodial officers
triggers.correction: Mandatory autopsies and fast-track trial within 90 days
